It handles complex, multi-turn conversations and takes real action across business systems, without relying on scripted flows. This webinar gives channel partners a practical walkthrough of the product. We'll cover what it does, how it differs from Five9's existing self-service offerings, and where it fits in a customer conversation. We'll unpack the shift from scripted to fully agentic and what it means for containment, cost, risk, revenue, and customer satisfaction. The session closes with a live demo. Partners will leave with the knowledge and tools to identify good-fit opportunities and bring Voice AI Agents confidently into customer conversations.
